F.name: source_search
F.description: Search the shared audited robotics source view with a literal substring.

F.name: source_read
F.description: Read an allowlisted relative file; begin at 1; at most 200 lines.

F.name: scratch_execute
F.description: Execute standard-library Python in isolated scratch. Set result to a JSON value. Robot calls use documented proxy functions; each nested call consumes a tool call. No simulator or network access.

F.name: finish
F.description: End this actor trial; the evaluator decides the outcome privately.

F.name: describe_device
F.description: Inspect typed channels, units, bounds and controller conventions.

F.name: read
F.description: Read a current sensor channel while physics is paused.

F.name: read_latest
F.description: Read all allowed observation channels at the current simulator step.

F.name: act
F.description: Apply one atomic controller command for bounded repeated steps.
